baseline_comparison.interpretation: Enum-normalization and invalid-evidence boundary changes did not alter keyed action, guardrail, or decision results. CI #148 matches #138 with zero changed rows across 687 combined action/decision error records. Categories overlap.

retrieval_metric_contract.invalid_evidence_policy: Evidence with non-VALID status is excluded from investigation model inputs and cited/used evidence IDs.
retrieval_metric_contract.validity_aggregation: Macro-average over 10 query-level ratios: valid retrieved candidates / retrieved candidates for that query; candidate counts vary and are not the invoice count.
retrieval_metric_contract.invalid_rejection_aggregation: Macro-average over queries with one or more invalid evidence labels; current frozen dataset denominator is 10 queries. Queries without invalid labels are excluded as not applicable.
